name: kihyun-skills
description: Claude Code mods (hooks plugins) from Ki Hyun Park's skills repo.

plugins.name: path-band
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with where the agent is working now and on which branch, as two chips: the worktree or repository with the path beneath it, and the branch (a short SHA when detached). It follows /cd and worktree moves; a long path gives way at its start so the branch stays whole.

plugins.name: thegraph-panel
plugins.description: While /thegraph runs: one line above the prompt with its steps in order, each marked, and the signals that fired, and a button that opens a pane with a gantt of the steps over the whole log as a table; the spinner and each turn's closing line carry the step and what the turn did.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Two rows above the prompt in three divided columns: context with the model, effort and cache hit rate; the 5-hour window with its pace (used over the window gone), when it runs out if it will, and its reset; the week with what it has left for each day to the reset (green while a day's share is to spare), and today's cost. Colour only when something needs saying.
